Description: Year-over-year % change of US building permits (from H Permit level)
Direction Convention: Higher (permits growing YoY) = housing/construction expansion (bullish equities)
Known Quirks: Growth rate centred near 0; permits are a classic leading indicator (LEI component); SAAR level, revised
Display Note: Positive permit YoY (permits above a year ago) marks housing-led expansion and risk-on conditions.
